learnings.insight: In this Cloud Agent sandbox neither the `gh` CLI nor the GitHub MCP tools (mcp__github__*) are available, and ToolSearch is disabled, so the documented integrator recipe (mcp__github__pull_request_read get_status/get_check_runs) cannot run. GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN env vars ARE present and the agent HTTPS proxy reaches api.github.com, so PR/check/ruleset state is reachable via `curl` against the REST API: /pulls/{n} (mergeable, mergeable_state, draft), /commits/{sha}/check-runs (App checks), /commits/{sha}/status (legacy statuses e.g. Vercel), and /repos/{o}/{r}/rules/branches/main (to prove required checks are ruleset-gated, not honor-system).
learnings.action: When gh/MCP are unavailable, use curl + $GITHUB_TOKEN against the REST endpoints above; always cross-check /rules/branches/main so 'green' is a real gate.
